neighbours.label: A word for a gap from or shift away from a reference point (a movement away from, miles away from, 50hp down on); close and toward stay quiet
fire: There has been a steady shift away from coal in the region.
You are still miles away from a real answer.
The car was 40hp down on power to its rivals.
Voters are drifting away from the old parties.
The team is six points down on the league leaders.
We are years away from a working vaccine.
Students moved away from physics at university.
This engine is well down on torque at low speed.
quiet: There has been a steady shift toward coal in the region.
You are very close to a real answer.
The car was equal on power to its rivals.
Voters are returning to the old parties.
The team is level with the league leaders.
We are close to a working vaccine.
Students moved into physics at university.
This engine is strong on torque at low speed.
